comment: PedalBuilder's two Harmonic Percolator builds (1590BB2 and 125B) after the Latent Lemon Hurts, both from this one schematic: a germanium Q1 and 2N3904 Q2 percolator with a Deep switch (adds 100n at the input and the 1M OSC trim across R2), a 2.7M plus 2M Octave trim in the Q2 feedback, Sputter and Harmonics pots, and a Ge/Si clipping switch. Per the post the builds differ only in Q1's gain and the silicon diodes.
